text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp begins. Meisho Doto is planning to spend her stay discreetly, not wanting to bother the talented T.M. Opera O and Admire Vega.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, reality far exceeds Meisho Doto's expectations—her peers, in full acknowledgment of her skills, welcome her into the group. Meisho Doto couldn't be happier.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Their summertime kicks off with an unexpected friend—a tanuki—coming along and quickly warming up to Doto.
